headline: TOR @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 4.39 at BOS 4.87, with a projected total of 9.27. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: TOR moved +0.32 runs while BOS moved +0.75, changing the projected margin by -0.43 runs. The projected total climbed +1.12, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -21.8%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jake Bennett has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.0 ER over the last 3 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ceddanne Rafaela, Willson Contreras, Ernie Clement, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
